text:
dean-ramirez: Hey team — heads up I'm going to Tokyo for ~3 months (partner's assignment). Dates 2025-06-01 -> 2025-08-31. Questions: will WFH allowance continue while I'm abroad? Any cap on internet/hotspot reimbursement overseas? Do I need to touch payroll or change homebase?

sami-people-ops: @dean-ramirez good to hear — short answers: stipend continues but prorated for partial months; equipment/internet reimbursements are allowed but need receipts and manager ok. Can you confirm you keep US homebase?

dean-ramirez: Yep keeping SF homebase. No local income expected.

alex-payroll: Thanks — keep homebase as SF in ADP. We'll log an international remote window. No change to withholding for a temporary trip <120 days typically, but if you exceed that we reassess state nexus and withholding. Submit dates to Travel & Remote Log (https://redwood.internal/travel-log) and cc payroll.

nina-benefits: Our medical plans cover emergency care outside the US only. For routine care or prescriptions in Japan, not covered. We recommend a short-term international health plan or travel insurance. If you need a benefits letter for immigration/landlord, we can provide one.

it-helpdesk: For VPN and MFA abroad, you shouldn't need changes but please test before you leave. If you need a temporary mobile hotspot stipend, keep receipts and tag expense code "travel-internet". Note: home internet stipend ($150/mo) will be prorated; travel hotspot is reimbursed as a separate one-off.

dean-ramirez: Any tax/permanent establishment risk for this length? Don't want surprises.

legal-bot: FYI: short stays (<183 days) normally don't create employment nexus or tax PE, but local immigration rules vary. If you plan to work physically in Japan beyond 90 days or take local contract work, contact Legal immediately.

sami-people-ops: Practicals: - Stipend proration example: June full month -> full stipend; August full month -> full stipend; if travel overlaps payroll cutoff we prorate by calendar days. - Equipment (one-off) claims via Expensify, code "equipment". - Keep receipts for travel SIM/hotspot.

dean-ramirez: Cool. Do we provide an employment verification/visa letter?

nina-benefits: We can issue benefits confirmation. @sami-people-ops can coordinate employment verification for visa purposes.

alex-payroll: Once you submit the Travel & Remote Log I'll mark payroll and confirm which payroll run will reflect any proration. If you end up traveling during a pay-period cutoff, expect proration shown in the next paystub.

it-helpdesk: Quick checklist from IT: 1) Test VPN access from a non-US IP 2) Ensure your MFA device is with you 3) Update emergency contact if needed 4) Ask IT for loaner travel adapter if required (limited supply).

dean-ramirez: Thanks! One more: will local phone/SMS 2FA break? Some carriers block foreign SMS.

it-helpdesk: Good call — use an authenticator app (Authy/Google Authenticator) or YubiKey where possible. If you rely on SMS, bring an international SIM or set up app-based 2FA before leaving.

sami-people-ops: I'll create a short confirmation thread with steps after you file the travel log. Also reminder: if the trip extends >120 days ping People Ops + Payroll + Legal.

dean-ramirez: Filing travel log now. Appreciate everyone :thumbsup:

legal-bot: NOTE: recurring remote work from a foreign country (e.g., multiple trips per year) can create permanent establishment or employment law obligations — escalate if this becomes regular.
